definitions.explanation: The arrangement and characteristics of a person's facial features, including the shape of the eyes, nose, mouth, and overall facial structure. Often used when describing someone's appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧{顔立|かおだ}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: That person has well-defined facial features.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}た→似る：01159_niru⟧{顔立|かおだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They have facial features similar to their mother's.

examples.japanese: {彫|ほ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{顔立|かおだ}ちで、⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えられる→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: With deep-set facial features, they sometimes get mistaken for a foreigner.

notes:
Focuses specifically on the structure and arrangement of facial features, not the face as a body part (⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧{顔立|かおだ}ち (well-proportioned features)
- {彫|ほ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{顔立|かおだ}ち (deep-set/chiseled features)
- ⟦はっきりした→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧{顔立|かおだ}ち (distinct features)
- {優|やさ}しい{顔立|かおだ}ち (gentle features)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}た→似る：01159_niru⟧{顔立|かおだ}ち (features resembling ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ is the general word for face
- ⟦{容貌|ようぼう}→容貌：18942_youbou⟧ / ⟦{風貌|ふうぼう}→風貌：14674_fuubou⟧ are more literary terms for overall appearance
- {顔立|かおだ}ち focuses on the physical structure of the face
